scope: Current release inventory image bytes; bounded quoted image-path candidates; existing active external-CSS audit; exact known scene tables and premium/native/woven/classic wheel catalog data shapes.
limitations: Quoted candidates may occur in inactive code, data or comments; they do not prove runtime use. Noninventory quoted candidates are nonblocking observations for later review, not proven active missing-file bugs.
Dynamic or generated paths, inline CSS variable resolution and computed cascade are incomplete. Unknowns remain explicit.
Byte-equality groups do not prove interchangeable URLs. Derived PNG/WebP/thumbnail variants are separate assets.
No file is classified as unused, removed, renamed, redirected or visually verified. No browser or physical Android test is performed.

wheelCatalog.meaning: Exact known builder and consumer shapes plus literal-table-derived candidates; no JavaScript execution, runtime reachability, loading or rendering proof.
